title: C-03: the 8-day reconcile applied MLB's post-cutoff re-scoring and overwrote two settled hits in local pick files (5/10, 8/20)
missing_evidence: a primary read of the two local_vs_contest_disagreement rows of the accepted W1.1 ledger (selection, date, slot, local_norm, contest_norm, comparison basis) — Phase 2 Route R, the §5.4(ii) authorized projection

B1 cron.log: the `CORRECTIONS FOUND` template event (count and dates only) at the 2026-05-16 and 2026-08-26 02:00 ET `bts reconcile` runs — Phase 2 Route R (template from cli.py reconcile; whether cron.log is retained back to 5/16 is unknown)
tier_reason: local grading state (pick-file results and the replayed streak.json) was overwritten against the BTS cutoff rule on two dates (reported), research reads consumed the altered grades, and the fix is main-only, so the defective 02:00 reconcile still runs on the box (B → A)

contract.text: A game day's BTS grade is frozen at 08:00 ET the next day and MLB statistic changes after that never count, so local grading must not change a date's result after that cutoff.
contract.source: BTS Official Rules 'Regarding Official Changes to MLB Game Statistics' (full page in the box evidence bundle; not in the repo excerpt section6.txt), as stated in docs/audit/2026-09-corrections-index.md C-03, the ce6676d body and ARCHITECTURE.md `bts reconcile` (ce6676d)

mechanism.text: reconcile_results re-graded every already-graded date in its 8-day lookback from MLB's current feed with no BTS-cutoff check, so the day+6 02:00 ET cron run applied MLB's in-place re-scoring (a single changed to a fielding error days after the game, with no new feed revision), overwrote the settled hit with a miss and replayed streak.json from the altered pick files; the CLI only echoed the correction to cron.log

mitigated.action: C-03 reading rule: the two pick files are kept as frozen evidence; readers use the contest ledger for delivered-day results (W1.1) and P-03 reports recorded and corrected numbers

residual.text: The fix is main-only and not deployed (ships with 2027): the box still runs the pre-fix 8-day reconcile at 02:00 ET, and the new 07:40 ET run exists only after `cron-setup-hetzner.sh install` on the box

Best-effort contract: a re-scoring between the last run and 08:00 ET (or after a failed 07:40 run) is never picked up; an empty correction list does not distinguish unchanged from unobserved; picks still None/unresolved/suspended are not first-graded by reconcile
Corrections are only echoed to cron.log: no alert, no observation receipts, no missed-check visibility and no contest-ledger finalization of entered days (2027 deployment-review follow-ups)
The two local pick files are not rewritten (frozen evidence); any reader of local results for those dates must apply C-03

watchdog.trigger: any write that changes a date's local result or slot_results after that date's 08:00 ET next-day cutoff, or, for an entered day, a local slot grade that differs from the contest ledger's settled round result
watchdog.recovery_assertion: for every entered date the local grade equals the contest's round result, and no local grade write is timestamped after the date's cutoff
